violation_type.typical_finding: The breezeway utilized by children to go outside had a strong cigarette odor.

finding_variants.text: The breezeway utilized by children to go outside had a strong cigarette odor.
At time of inspection, operation backyard was observed with dog feces.
Dog waste was found in the backyard and was accessible to the children.
